AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
This app manages tasks for teams: creating and assigning tasks, updating task status, and searching users.
Operational Patterns: - Always use 'searchUsers' to resolve user handles to internal IDs before calling 'assignTask'. - Prefer 'batchUpdateStatus' when modifying more than three tasks simultaneously to reduce latency.
Constraints: - All functions share a limit of 10 requests per minute.
